title: Categories
description: Configure product categories for catalogs across your tenant.

help.title: About product categories
help.overview: Categories sort your products into a tree, such as Clothing › Shirts. Customers browse and filter your shop by them, and a product can be in several.

sections.title: Each category
items: Leave Parent category empty for a top level. Order sorts categories on the same level, lowest first.
A discount aimed at a category applies when any of the product's categories matches.
A pricing rule aimed at a category looks only at the product's first category.
Deleting a category doesn't delete its products; they keep their other categories.
Your service listings use their own categories, under Listing categories.
